summary: Iter23 — SafeTradie Phase 3 Part 2 (15 NEW doc types, 31 total) validated end-to-end. Backend pytest 58/58 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_doc_library_phase3_part2.py (~20.5s): GET /api/docs/types returns exactly 31 types; category counts verified 20 safety / 1 worker / 7 trade / 3 plant; all 15 new prefixes correct (GAS/PT/BFT/TMP/PPS/SCF/WAH/LOTO/MHR/NOISE/SIL/WPS/TT/FSP/EMP); all 14 NEW table/chip field type names (backflow_tests, tmp_signage, loto_points, mh_factors, mh_controls, noise_measurements, silica_tasks, rpe_items, test_tag_items, fire_detection, fire_equipment, emp_aspects, waste_streams, emp_compliance) registered on correct fields; for ALL 15 new types — POST creates with doc_id+reference, GET /api/docs?doc_type=X filters with no _id, GET single returns doc, GET /{id}/pdf returns application/pdf magic=%PDF size>5000 (actual 17-20KB); PATCH persists tmp.speed_zone+road_class and loto.stored_energy_steps+personnel_clear with re-GET verification; DELETE soft-archive then hard-delete (404) works on welding_procedure; auth 401/403 enforced on welding_procedure/loto/emp; Phase 2 + Phase 3 Part 1 regression: jsa + whs_mgmt_plan + ccew still create+PDF successfully. Frontend verified live on owner@safetradie.demo against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: /dashboard/document-library hub renders ALL 31 cat-type-* cards; 5 target new cards visible (cat-type-{tmp,loto,welding_procedure,fire_safety_plan,emp}). Welding Procedure E2E: /dashboard/document-library/welding_procedure -> New -> doc-form -> fill field-wps_number + field-welding_process -> doc-save -> PDF download WPS-2026-0004.pdf (20519 bytes) triggered via doc-pdf. Spot-checked 5 NEW table widgets render without errors: backflow_test/field-tests, noise_assessment/field-measurements, test_tag_register/field-items, emp/field-aspects, silica_plan/field-tasks. Confirmed sibling 'Add row' button exists next to widget container (not child of widget) — all widgets have Add-row capability. Zero .error elements on any tested page. Phase 3 Part 2 is good to ship.

integration_issues.issue: After successful save, URL stays at /dashboard/document-library/{type}/new instead of redirecting to /dashboard/document-library/{type}/{doc_id}. PDF still downloads correctly because saved doc_id is held in component state, but a browser refresh or back-nav after save loses the unsaved-looking route. Minor UX — not blocking.

Save success toast was not detected in DOM during automated test (queried [data-sonner-toast], [role=status], [class*=toast], li[data-type] returned empty). PDF generation confirms save succeeded. Either the toast auto-dismissed before the 4.5s poll, or save is silent. Suggest adding data-testid="save-toast" for testability and ensuring a user-visible confirmation remains for 3-5s.

design_issues.screen: DocumentForm (all date/datetime fields across 15 new types)
issues: STILL uses native browser <input type='date'/'datetime-local'> rendering mm/dd/yyyy placeholder — carryover from iter20/21/22. Recommend shadcn Calendar + Popover for visual consistency with rest of app.

design_issues.screen: FieldRenderer table widgets (backflow_tests, noise_measurements, loto_points, etc.)
issues: 'Add row' button is rendered as a sibling AFTER the [data-testid='field-*'] container rather than inside it. Works functionally but makes scoped test selectors brittle (tests have to query the parent). Consider moving Add-row button inside the widget container or giving it its own data-testid like 'add-row-{field_key}'.

(Nice-to-have) Add data-testid="doc-save-toast" and ensure the save confirmation stays visible for at least 3-5s to aid QA automation.
(Nice-to-have) Expose an 'add-row-{field_key}' data-testid on the Add row button or nest it inside the [data-testid='field-*'] container.
(Pre-existing carryover) iter21 test assertion hardcoded len(types)==8 — now fails because there are 31. Update to ==31 or drop (iter22/iter23 already cover it).
(Pre-existing carryover) Replace native date/datetime-local inputs in DocumentForm FieldRenderer with shadcn Calendar.
(Pre-existing carryover) Wrap WeasyPrint write_pdf in asyncio.wait_for(timeout=30) inside docs_module.get_pdf for robustness on large docs (test_tag_register with many items could grow).
(Pre-existing carryover) Add /api/docs/stats aggregation endpoint so DocumentLibraryHub per-category counts don't require fetching every doc.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/docs_module.py is now ~2100+ lines (was 1249 after Phase 3 Part 1). File-size guideline (>700) is now severely exceeded — strongly recommend splitting into (a) docs_pdf.py for the 31 render_* functions + _common_css, (b) docs_registry.py for 31 register_doc_type() calls, (c) docs_module.py for routes + CRUD. Cost of carrying this file forward increases per phase.

DocumentForm.jsx FieldRenderer now has 18+ table-type if/else branches (plumbing_items, backflow_tests, tmp_signage, loto_points, mh_factors, mh_controls, noise_measurements, silica_tasks, rpe_items, test_tag_items, fire_detection, fire_equipment, emp_aspects, waste_streams, emp_compliance, plus Phase 3 Part 1 responsibilities/asbestos_items/test_results/work_items). All share identical shape (array of objects with fixed column keys). Strongly recommend one generic 'table' field type driven by spec.columns=[{key,label,type}] in the registry — eliminates both backend _f('..', type=...) duplication AND the frontend renderer chain. Would shrink both files significantly and be Phase 4+ future-proof.

create_doc / update_doc still accept arbitrary dict body without per-type Pydantic validation (noted iter22). Risk now compounds with 31 types — a typo'd field key on emp or silica_plan silently persists. Suggest building Pydantic models from each spec['fields'] at registration time.
PATCH /api/docs/{doc_id} still does NOT bump version — compliance-audit requirement for docs transitioning draft -> in_use / issued. Carryover from iter21.

Registry has 20 safety docs, 7 trade docs — they are all rendered in a single SafetyDocuments category column in the hub (observed in screenshot). Long column may scroll. Consider grouping safety into sub-sections (Permits / Plans / Assessments) for nav ergonomics once >15 items per category.

No input validation that table-type fields (e.g. backflow_test.tests, noise_assessment.measurements, test_tag_register.items) contain >=1 row before POST — same empty-table issue flagged in iter22. Registered doc can be saved + PDF'd with 0 rows, producing empty-state PDFs. Acceptable for draft, risky on status transition to 'issued'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical flows (hub 31-card render + welding_procedure create+save+PDF + 5 new widget spot-checks); 2 minor UX findings filed (save URL not updating, toast not detectable in DOM)

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — Phase 3 Part 2 schema-registry extension works end-to-end per spec. No new routes were needed; the 15 new doc types reuse the generic /api/docs/* CRUD as designed. Only minor UX gaps are (a) form URL not updating to /{doc_id} after save and (b) save toast not auto-discoverable in DOM for automation — neither blocks user flow, both were noted as action items.
